answer_text:
To calculate the volume-weighted average density, use the formula:

$$
\text{Volume-Weighted Average Density} = \frac{\sum (\text{Volume} \times \text{Density})}{\sum \text{Volume}}
$$

Given:
- 80 bbl at 10.1 ppg
- 120 bbl at 10.7 ppg
- 100 bbl at 11.2 ppg

$$
\text{Numerator} = (80 \times 10.1) + (120 \times 10.7) + (100 \times 11.2) = 808 + 1284 + 1120 = 3212
$$
$$
\text{Denominator} = 80 + 120 + 100 = 300
$$
$$
\text{Volume-Weighted Average Density} = \frac{3212}{300} = 10.707 \, \text{ppg}
$$

**Answer: 10.71 ppg** (rounded to two decimal places).
